title: Resolution to set 9% late-tax interest rate for mid-value properties
summary: This resolution sets the interest rate at 9 percent per year for fiscal year 2027 on unpaid property taxes for properties assessed between $250,000 and $450,000, or co-ops valued similarly per unit. The rate matches the level in place since fiscal year 2025, despite the Banking Commission recommending 15 percent. The Council notes delinquency has been declining, suggesting the current rate is already effective.
